title: Transfinite predication category
description: The transfinite predication category generated by predicating. Predicating opens this object from the potential aperiodic-articulation-cell: it carries the predication-cell-set and the predication-fiber-functor precursor whose raw contravariant data is later packaged by positing as predication-fibration. Positing is the next generator inside this layer, opening the scott-continuous-posit-category; predication-fibration is then an object inside that Scott-continuous posit category. Settling is then inside positing as the finite-settlement-algebra projection. This object is therefore not generic category theory assumed in advance; it is the predicating-generated layer from which ordinary categorical structure is later recovered as a regime shadow.
